llms.intro: Lenticule Science is the research company of the 561 Group. It develops Relationality and Obsmetrologia into mathematics, philosophy and agent research for a living Web. Publications cover the Jiangshi Web, reflective revision, four-valued logic, concurrent agents, machine-payable markets, organizational science and formal mathematics in Lean 4.
